title: Pure Thunder Dragon
summary: Pure Thunder Dragon build, revolving around Thunder monsters whose effects trigger from the hand by discarding themselves and trigger secondary effects when banished or sent from the field to the GY. The deck converts hand activations into suffocating floodgates and Quick Effect board destruction.

summary.title: Starters
points: Thunder Dragondark discards itself as a Quick Effect to add another copy, and searches any Thunder Dragon card from the Deck when banished or sent from the field to the GY.
Thunder Dragonroar discards itself to recover a banished or GY Thunder Dragon card, and Special Summons a Thunder Dragon from the Deck in Defense Position when banished or sent from field to GY.
Thunder Dragonhawk discards itself to Special Summon a banished or GY Thunder Dragon monster, and mulligans your hand when banished or sent from field to GY.
Thunder Dragon discards itself to add up to 2 copies of itself from the Deck to the hand, easily satisfying the hand-effect condition for Colossus.
Thunder Dragonmatrix discards as a Quick Effect to boost a Thunder monster by 500 ATK, and searches another copy when banished or sent from field to GY.

summary.title: Opening: Dragondark + Dragonhawk
steps: Discard Thunder Dragondark to search another Thunder Dragondark from your Deck to your hand.
Discard Thunder Dragonhawk to Special Summon the discarded Thunder Dragondark from your GY.
Tribute Thunder Dragondark to Special Summon Thunder Dragon Colossus from your Extra Deck (enabled because a Thunder monster activated in hand this turn).
Thunder Dragondark triggers upon leaving the field, searching Thunder Dragon Fusion from your Deck.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Thunder Dragon Colossus stops the opponent from adding cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them, and protects itself from destruction by banishing a Thunder monster from the GY.
Thunder Dragon Titan destroys 1 card on the field as a Quick Effect whenever a Thunder monster's effect activates in the hand, and protects itself by banishing 2 cards from the GY.
Thunder Dragonlord summons itself by banishing a Level 8 or lower Thunder monster from hand or field, providing targeting immunity to Thunder monsters during the opponent's turn.
Thunder Dragon Thunderstormech recycles banished Thunder monsters back to the Deck and copies the discard effect of a Thunder monster in your GY.
S:P Little Knight provides spot banishment on summon and can banish two face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Thunder Dragon Fusion Fusion Summons a Thunder Fusion Monster by shuffling materials back into the Deck from field, GY, or face-up banished cards, and can banish itself from the GY on subsequent turns to search any Thunder monster.
Thunder Dragon Discharge prevents Thunder monster effects from being negated and banishes a Thunder monster from the Deck to destroy an opponent's Spell or Trap whenever a Thunder effect activates.
Thunder Dragons' Hundred Thunders revives a Thunder monster from the GY and then Special Summons as many monsters with that name as possible from the GY, banishing them when they leave.
